images.title: Reflex angle at a vertex
images.purpose: Show that the smaller angle and the reflex angle together make a full turn of 360°.
images.composition: One large angle with two coloured arcs around its vertex and an equation line below.
images.exact_structure: One vertex with 2 grey #6B7280 rays. The small angle of 100° between them has an arc in teal #0072B2. The larger angle on the outside has an arc in amber #E69F00 and is exactly 260°. Exactly 2 rays, 2 arcs, 1 equation line.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The two angles fill the full turn.
images.description: Two rays from a vertex with the inside angle of 100° in teal and the reflex angle of 260° in amber, adding to 360°.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to trace both arcs and say they make one full turn.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture of the angle itself; one clean image carries it.
